title: Hyder ke janaze pe tha Hasnain ka nouha
body:
Hyder ke janaze pe tha Hasnain ka noha
Baba mere baba , Baba mere baba
1) Hai hai humare sar se utha baap ka saya , Kisne hume yateem kiya wa musibata , Hai Ashkbaar aaj yateemane Fatima , Baba mere baba…….
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Kaisa gazab yeh masjide kufa me hogaya , Kaisa yeh zulm hai bine muljim ne kardiya , Farqe Ali douneem hua wa musibata , Baba mere baba…….
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Rote hai sar ko peet ke karte hue ye bain
lekar chale gileem me moula ko noore ain, hamraah saath aati hai ab roohe mustafa
Baba mere baba…….
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Baba ke zaqmi hone ki jis dum khabar mili , Halat Ali ke betiyo ki gham se ghair thi , Aaho buka se arshe baree'n kaampne laga , Baba mere baba…….
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Zainab tadapke kehti hai baba ko kya hua , Kulsoom roke kehti hai hay hay hui jafa , Dekha jo farqe paak tou dil sabka phat gaya , Baba mere baba…….
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Zaalim ne kaisi tegh se mara Ali ko haye , Jab saamne layeen ko Ashaab leke aaye , Qaatil ki mushke khooldo kehne lage moula , Baba mere baba…….
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Noha Ali ka tune yeh purdard hai likha , Maatam kuna hai Anjumane Nasere Aza , Sehne haram se aati hai Hyder yahi sada , Baba mere baba…….
